new_value: {"notes":"Implemented current Rule 5 link-local OSCORE compression on top of the accumulated C SCHC work after explicit ownership clearance. The selector now fully parses CoAP options, accepts only RFC 8613-valid Object-Security values, rejects duplicate/reserved/truncated options and empty payload markers, and prevents valid OSCORE content from being relabeled under plaintext Rule 0/1 when Rule 5 constraints do not match. Rule 5 emits the canonical v3 174-bit residue: hop limit, fe80::/64 IIDs, CoAP-port low nibbles, and CoAP fixed fields, with token/options/ciphertext tail unchanged. It validates exact link-local prefix, zero TC/flow, 5680..5695 port block, TKL, UDP checksum, output capacity, and 22,554-byte profile maximum before the first output write. Added isolated lichen/tests/schc_rule5_compress covering canonical shared Python-oracle bytes, valid/invalid OSCORE option forms, selector fallbacks, checksum/address/port/TC constraints, atomic error output, and exact 22,554 accepted / 22,555 rejected boundary. Validation: strict host C build succeeded; focused C test passed under UBSan before shared-process contention and passed again in a fresh non-sanitized build; Python python/tests/schc/test_rule5.py 14 passed; Rust rule5_compression 6 passed in unique CARGO_TARGET_DIR; focused cppcheck clean; git diff --check clean. A later 10-second ctest wrapper timed out during shared SCHC test contention, while the same built binary completed PASS directly; no shared processes were killed."}
